faqItems.question: What is Explosão Solar?
faqItems.answer: Explosão Solar is a news portal dedicated to explanatory journalism: the kind that places context above speed and treats readers as people who want to understand, not just know. We cover Brazil, the World, Politics, Economics, Technology, Science, Sports, and Culture — going beyond the facts to explain what they mean and what is likely to come next.

faqItems.question: What is the portal's editorial stance?
faqItems.answer: Our editorial stance rests on three pillars: absolute independence, rigorous verification through primary sources, and in-depth explanation. We prefer to publish correctly rather than publish first. No advertiser has prior access to our editorial agenda, nor any power of veto over the newsroom's publishing decisions.

faqItems.question: How is content produced and reviewed?
faqItems.answer: Every story begins with an editorial brief, goes through verification using primary sources — official documents, public data, studies, and named experts — and undergoes dual review before publication: fact-checking and copy editing. Any updates made after publication are always flagged with a visible date and explanation for the reader.

faqItems.question: I found an error in an article. How do I request a correction?
faqItems.answer: Write to contato@explosaosolar.com with the article link, a description of the error, and, if possible, the source supporting the correction. We review every request. If the error is confirmed, we correct the text immediately and add a transparency note indicating what was changed and when. Serious errors are also highlighted at the top of the article.

faqItems.question: Does the portal display advertising? How is it identified?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The portal is funded through programmatic advertising and, occasionally, sponsored content — always labeled with the tags Advertising or Sponsored Content, without exception. Advertisers have no prior access to our editorial agenda and no power of veto over editorial decisions. The separation between journalism and advertising is absolute.

faqItems.question: How does Explosão Solar handle my personal data?
faqItems.answer: We process personal data in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018), based on the principle of data minimization: we collect only what is necessary to operate the portal, measure audience, display advertising, and respond to messages. All details — including your rights as a data subject — are available in our Privacy Policy. To exercise any right, write to contato@explosaosolar.com.

faqItems.question: How do I contact the newsroom?
faqItems.answer: The official channel is the e-mail address contato@explosaosolar.com. Through it we receive story suggestions, correction requests, press inquiries, commercial proposals, and personal data-related requests. We respond within 5 business days; requests related to the LGPD follow the statutory deadlines.

faqItems.question: Can I suggest a story?
faqItems.answer: With pleasure. Send your suggestion to contato@explosaosolar.com with the subject line Story suggestion, describing the topic, why it is relevant now, and, if possible, suggesting sources or experts who could contribute. We read all suggestions, but publication depends on editorial evaluation and cannot be guaranteed.

faqItems.question: Can I use, cite, or republish content from Explosão Solar?
faqItems.answer: Short quotations are freely permitted, provided they are accompanied by credit to Explosão Solar and a link to the original article. The full or substantial reproduction of texts, images, and other materials — including for training automated systems or populating databases — requires prior written authorization, requested by e-mail at contato@explosaosolar.com.

faqItems.question: How does the newsletter work and how do I unsubscribe?
faqItems.answer: The newsletter is an editorial digest featuring the newsroom's top stories and analyses, delivered by e-mail. Subscription only occurs with explicit consent; your data is used exclusively to send each edition. To unsubscribe, click the unsubscribe link in the footer of any edition or write to contato@explosaosolar.com. Removal is immediate and hassle-free.

aboutHtml:
Who We Are

Explosão Solar is a news portal built on a simple and non-negotiable premise: context matters more than speed. In an information landscape dominated by haste and superficiality, we have chosen the opposite path — in-depth coverage, accessible language, and unconditional respect for our readers' intelligence.

Our mission is explanatory journalism: it is not enough to recount what happened; we must explain why it happened, what it means, and what is likely to come next. We cover Brazil, the World, Politics, Economics, Technology, Science, Sports, and Culture — with the same editorial standards across every beat.

In addition to daily coverage, Explosão Solar operates a real-time alert system for events such as earthquakes, solar storms, and extreme weather phenomena, delivered directly to the reader's device the moment they are confirmed. We publish in three languages — Portuguese, English, and Spanish — because we believe quality journalism has no borders.

Our Values

  • Accuracy: every published claim is supported by verifiable sources — documents, public data, studies, and experts identified by name and title.
  • Context: no fact exists in a vacuum. Our articles explain background, causes, and consequences so that readers leave knowing more than when they arrived.
  • Independence: editorial decisions belong exclusively to the newsroom. Advertisers and commercial partners do not set, edit, or veto content — without exception.
  • Transparency: when we make mistakes — and every serious outlet does — we correct them swiftly and leave a record of what was changed, when, and why.
  • Clarity: we write in plain language, free of unnecessary jargon, sensationalism, and promises the text does not deliver.

Commitment to Corrections

We maintain an active corrections policy. Any reader can flag an error by e-mail at contato@explosaosolar.com. Every request is reviewed by the newsroom; when an error is confirmed, the article is corrected immediately and receives a transparency note documenting the change. We view corrections not as an embarrassment, but as an essential part of our trust agreement with our readers.

How We Are Funded

The portal is supported by clearly identified digital advertising, kept fully separate from editorial content. That separation is absolute and non-negotiable: readers will always know what is a news article and what is an advertisement.

Depth is not slowness — it is respect. Respect for the fact, the source, and the reader.

— The Explosão Solar Editorial Team
privacyHtml:
Privacy Policy

Effective date: August 1, 2026.

This Privacy Policy describes how the portal Explosão Solar, accessible at explosaosolar.com, collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects the personal data of its readers and visitors, in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018) and other applicable Brazilian regulations, including the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Marco Civil da Internet — Law No. 12,965/2014). By using the portal, you confirm that you have read and understood this Policy.

1. Data Controller

The controller of personal data processed in connection with the portal is Explosão Solar, responsible for the website explosaosolar.com. For any matter related to privacy and data protection, including the exercise of rights under the LGPD, the official contact channel is the e-mail address contato@explosaosolar.com, which also serves as the data protection officer (DPO) channel.

2. What Data We Collect

We collect only the data necessary to operate the portal and provide our services, in the following circumstances:

  • Browsing data: when you visit the portal, we automatically collect, through cookies and similar technologies, information such as IP address, date and time of access, browser type and version, operating system, screen resolution, pages visited, time spent, referral source, and device identifiers. This data is processed predominantly in aggregate form.
  • Contact form and e-mail: when you write to us, we collect your name (if provided), e-mail address, and the content of the message, solely to respond to your request.
  • Newsletter: upon subscription, we collect your e-mail address and, optionally, your name, as well as consent records (date, time, and source of subscription) and delivery metrics such as opens and clicks, used to maintain a healthy mailing list.

We do not deliberately collect sensitive personal data (such as health information, religion, or political affiliation) or data from children and adolescents. If we identify such data submitted spontaneously, it will be deleted, unless there is a contrary legal obligation.

3. Purposes of Processing

  • To provide, operate, and improve the portal and your reading experience;
  • To measure audience, understand which content interests readers, and guide editorial decisions;
  • To display advertising, including personalized advertising where consent has been given;
  • To respond to messages, story suggestions, correction requests, and data subject requests;
  • To send the newsletter to subscribers;
  • To prevent fraud, abuse, and attacks, and to ensure platform security;
  • To comply with legal and regulatory obligations.

4. Legal Bases

We process personal data based on the following legal grounds set forth in Article 7 of the LGPD:

  • Consent (Art. 7, I): for newsletter delivery and for non-essential advertising and analytics cookies;
  • Legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX): for basic audience measurement, platform security, and service improvement, always respecting your reasonable expectations and fundamental rights;
  • Compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation (Art. 7, II): for keeping access logs as required by the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Marco Civil da Internet);
  • Regular exercise of rights (Art. 7, VI): when necessary in judicial, administrative, or arbitration proceedings.

5. Data Sharing

Explosão Solar does not sell personal data. We share data only in the following circumstances:

  • Audience analytics tools: we use statistics and measurement services that process browsing data on our behalf to generate aggregated reports on portal usage;
  • Advertising networks and partners: advertising platforms may collect identifiers and browsing data, subject to consent, for the delivery and measurement of campaigns;
  • Infrastructure providers: hosting, e-mail delivery, and security services strictly necessary for portal operations;
  • Public authorities: where there is a legal obligation, court order, or request from a competent authority.

We require all contracted processors to make commitments to confidentiality and compliance with the LGPD. Where international data transfers occur (for example, to servers of global providers), they will be carried out with appropriate safeguards, in accordance with Articles 33 and following of the LGPD.

6. Retention and Deletion

We retain data only for as long as necessary for the purposes of this Policy: access logs are kept for a minimum of 6 months, as required by the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Marco Civil da Internet); contact messages are kept for as long as necessary to handle the request and for up to 2 years for historical reference; newsletter data is kept while the subscription is active and deleted upon unsubscription, except for minimum records evidencing consent and opt-out. Upon expiry of the applicable periods, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

7. Data Subject Rights (Art. 18 of the LGPD)

You may exercise the following rights at any time, free of charge:

  • Confirmation of the existence of processing;
  • Access to your data;
  • Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
  • Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary, excessive, or unlawfully processed data;
  • Portability of your data to another service provider, subject to applicable regulation;
  • Deletion of data processed based on your consent;
  • Information about the entities with which we share data;
  • Information about the possibility of withholding consent and the consequences of refusal;
  • Withdrawal of consent, at any time;
  • Objection to processing carried out under other legal grounds, in the event of non-compliance with the LGPD.

To exercise any of these rights, send an e-mail to contato@explosaosolar.com with the subject line Personal Data, describing your request. We may ask for additional information to verify your identity as a security measure. We will respond within the statutory deadlines and, where immediate action is not possible, we will inform you of the reasons. If you believe your rights have not been upheld, you may file a complaint with the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

8. Information Security

We adopt technical and administrative measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access and accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure, or dissemination, including traffic encryption (HTTPS), restricted access controls, activity logging, and periodic vendor reviews. No system is completely secure; should a security incident occur that poses a significant risk to data subjects, we will notify the ANPD and those affected, in accordance with Article 48 of the LGPD.

9. Cookies

The use of cookies and similar technologies is detailed in our Cookie Policy, which forms part of this Privacy Policy and explains how to manage your preferences and withdraw consent.

10. Changes to This Policy

This Policy may be updated to reflect legal, technological, or operational changes. The current version will always be published on this page, with the effective date indicated at the top. Significant changes will be highlighted on the portal. Continued use of the site following the publication of changes constitutes acknowledgment of the updated version. Questions about this Policy may be sent to contato@explosaosolar.com.
cookiesHtml:
Cookie Policy

Effective date: August 1, 2026.

This Cookie Policy explains transparently what cookies are, which categories the portal Explosão Solar (explosaosolar.com) uses, what they are used for, and how you can manage, disable, or withdraw your consent. It supplements our Privacy Policy and follows the guidelines of the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018) and the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Marco Civil da Internet — Law No. 12,965/2014).

1. What Cookies Are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser or on your device when you visit it. They allow the website to recognize your device on subsequent visits, remember preferences, understand how content is used, and enable the display of advertising. Similar technologies, such as tracking pixels, tags, and local storage, serve equivalent functions and, for the purposes of this Policy, are treated together under the term cookies.

Cookies may be classified by origin — first-party (set by Explosão Solar) or third-party (set by partners such as analytics tools and advertising networks) — and by duration — session cookies (deleted when you close your browser) or persistent cookies (stored for a set period).

2. Categories of Cookies We Use

2.1. Essential Cookies

These are indispensable to the functioning of the portal and cannot be disabled in our systems, as without them the site simply does not operate correctly. Their legal basis is legitimate interest and the technical necessity of providing the service. Typical uses:

  • Maintaining navigation stability and security, including protection against attacks and fraud;
  • Recording your cookie consent choice so that the notice does not reappear on every page;
  • Load balancing servers and ensuring correct page delivery;
  • Remembering basic display preferences during the session.

2.2. Performance and Analytics Cookies

These collect information about how visitors use the portal — most-read pages, reading time, referral sources, devices used — predominantly in aggregate form. This data helps us understand what interests readers, identify problems, and guide editorial decisions. Typical uses:

  • Measuring total and per-article audience;
  • Identifying loading errors and performance bottlenecks;
  • Comparing the performance of different content formats;
  • Generating aggregated website usage statistics.

2.3. Advertising Cookies

Set by us and our advertising partners, these allow us to display ads, limit how often the same ad appears, measure campaign effectiveness, and — when you have given consent — present more relevant advertising based on your browsing interests. Typical uses:

  • Displaying advertisements that financially support the portal;
  • Measuring impressions and clicks on campaigns;
  • Limiting ad display frequency (frequency capping);
  • Personalizing ads based on interests, subject to consent.

Performance and advertising cookies are only activated after your consent, recorded through the cookie notice displayed on your first visit.

3. How to Manage or Disable Cookies in Your Browser

In addition to the options in our consent notice, you can manage cookies directly in your browser — blocking new cookies, deleting existing ones, or receiving alerts before they are stored. Here is how to do so in the main browsers:

  • Google Chrome: open the menu (three dots) and go to Settings, then Privacy and security, then Third-party cookies (or Site settings, Cookies and site data). There you can block third-party cookies, delete cookies when you close the browser, and remove data from specific sites.
  • Mozilla Firefox: open the menu and go to Settings, then Privacy & Security. Under Enhanced Tracking Protection, choose Standard, Strict, or Custom mode; under Cookies and Site Data, use Clear Data or Manage Exceptions.
  • Safari (Mac): go to Safari, then Settings (or Preferences), Privacy tab, and check Prevent cross-site tracking or Block all cookies; under Manage Website Data you can remove stored cookies. On iPhone and iPad, go to Settings, Safari, and adjust the Privacy & Security options.

Please note: blocking all cookies, including essential ones, may impair the functioning of parts of the portal.

4. Consent and How to Withdraw It

On your first visit, we display a cookie notice that allows you to accept, decline, or customize the non-essential categories. Your choice is recorded and can be changed at any time. To withdraw or modify your consent, you may: (a) access the cookie preferences again through the link available in the portal's footer; (b) delete the site's cookies in your browser, which will cause the notice to be displayed again; or (c) write to contato@explosaosolar.com for guidance. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to it, nor does it prevent the use of essential cookies necessary for the website to function.

5. Third-Party Cookies and Responsibility

Cookies set by analytics and advertising partners are also governed by those third parties' own privacy policies, which we recommend consulting. Explosão Solar selects partners that declare compliance with the LGPD but does not directly control the processing they carry out on their own platforms.

6. Updates to This Policy

This Cookie Policy may be updated to reflect changes in our practices, our partners, or applicable legislation. The current version will always be available on this page, with the effective date at the top. If you have any questions, please contact us at contato@explosaosolar.com.
